description: This file defines the MultiTaskCompletionSource class, an alternative to TaskCompletionSource that completes after a specified number of signals are received. It manages synchronization for multiple signals and provides a task that completes once the count reaches zero.

classes.name: MultiTaskCompletionSource
classes.description: A class that completes a task after receiving a specified number of signals, useful for coordinating multiple asynchronous operations.

methods.name: MultiTaskCompletionSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the completion source with a count of signals to wait for.

methods.name: Task
methods.description: Property that returns the task which completes when the count reaches zero.

methods.name: SetOneResult
methods.description: Signals the completion source, decrementing the count and completing the task if the count reaches zero.
